title: Fix generic Monster completeness and positively prove ordinary Doom Walker (RunningMonster type 8 / special 11)

supersedes.retainedTruth: R7-107 remains valid for the separate Doomsday SuperRunningBoss special-32 activity-boss contract.

trigger: User reported Doom Walker missing from Monster scan; user specifically identified level 160 and stated Doom Walker levels advance by 10.

rootCause.productionBefore: Dedicated generic Monster scans used one native LOD2 whole-world MarchDataManager snapshot.
rootCause.liveFinding: Ordinary Doom Walker WorldMarch rows are materialized in LOD0 coverage but were not reliably present in the LOD2 shortcut.
rootCause.notNormalizerBug: The Monster normalizer already accepted the rows; acquisition visibility was the missing boundary.

implementation.genericMonsterAcquisition: Exact adaptive LOD0 10,000-cell AOI union over the 1000x1000 world.
implementation.zombieBossUnchangedSemantics: Zombie Boss retains native LOD2 whole-world snapshot plus serialized detail path.
implementation.doomsdayRefreshOptimization: Read-only ActivityDoomsdayMainInfo refresh is issued at most once per scanRunId instead of once per AOI request.
implementation.filterCeiling: No legacy level ceiling: backend accepts maxLevel=220 and frontend Monster level steps derive from observed maximum.

adjacentLiveAcceptance.purpose: Prove the highest active Doom Walker tier observed immediately before the final strategy-label rerun.

safety.networkReadOnlyQuery: ActivityDoomsdayMainInfo only; ordinary Doom Walker rows came from passive WorldMarch AOI materialization.

limits: Doom Walker population is dynamic; individual levels/counts vary between scans.

monsterType/monsterSpecialType runtime fields on these WorldMarch rows are zero in the observed client; authoritative classification comes from the resolved Monster template configType=8/configSpecial=11.
